name: Janus kinase 3

function.text: JAK3 encodes tyrosine-protein kinase JAK3. Annotated molecular activities include protein tyrosine kinase activity and non-membrane spanning protein tyrosine kinase activity. It participates in intracellular signal transduction and cell differentiation.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to T-B+ severe combined immunodeficiency due to JAK3 deficiency (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma; T-cell prolymphocytic leukemia; T-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
